facts.value: Initialization receives a pool size, allocates one backing region through `HSD_MemAlloc`, constructs the SisLib free list over that region, and clears five archive and SIS-table slots. Text creation obtains `HSD_Text` objects and auxiliary storage from this pool and optionally associates them with a camera-context GObj. Per-font archive loading resolves a named SIS table, and indexed entries from that table flow into each text object's SIS buffer and reset state. Shutdown unloads retained archives and returns the backing pool to HSD memory management.

facts.value: Initialization overwrites roots with a new arena and empty registries. Reset requests text/context cleanup and rebuilds the saved arena while retaining font slots. Final shutdown additionally releases occupied archives and backing memory without clearing the arena pointer. Per-font cleanup filters runtime objects and archive slots but has a consecutive-context predecessor bug. Deferred GObj callbacks impose a lifecycle boundary requirement.
